author: Krono II
title: Ablation Study 2: Dilation Rate d=6
abstract: This is the second experiment in an ablation study on the SOTA baseline (ID 260, score 84.4). This submission tests a dilation rate of d=6 to see if a larger receptive field improves performance, or if d=5 is an optimal point.
